IF
TextEvent("IncompleteMasterwork_GiveBark")
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce_Reset("Debug_FOR_GiveBark")
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("Debug_FOR_GiveBark")
THEN
ToInventory(S_UND_SussurBark_ec9aee1d-4965-4620-a81a-a05ccefd8b05, _Player, 1, 1, 1);

PROC
PROC_BlockUseOfItem(_Char, (ITEM)S_FOR_MagicMirror_7b0d83fb-8cda-4b55-b1b7-fa5073ae5c89)
AND
NOT DB_FOR_ThayanCellar_TrapActive(1)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)FOR_ThayanCellar_Event_OpenMirror_d1da5931-fb01-4f5d-940a-74d2b1e7aff8)
AND
QRY_SpeakerIsAvailable((ITEM)S_FOR_MagicMirror_7b0d83fb-8cda-4b55-b1b7-fa5073ae5c89)
AND
DB_Players(_Char)
AND
QRY_FOR_ThayanCellar_NoReflection((CHARACTER)_Char)
AND
QRY_StartDialog_Fixed((DIALOGRESOURCE)FOR_ThayanCellar_MagicMirror_f899b723-7363-c89d-ec8f-ec1a7dc86454, (ITEM)S_FOR_MagicMirror_7b0d83fb-8cda-4b55-b1b7-fa5073ae5c89, _Char)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

IF
AttackedBy(S_MOO_MelodiaLetterPlank_6276edbc-cc09-4569-9050-f70f77ab2ac8, _Player, _, _, _, _, _)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag(MOO_KethericsChambers_State_FoundPlank_2466fd50-41a4-4274-8be4-81347e2a2af5)
THEN
SetDualEntityEvent(_Player, S_MOO_MelodiaLetterPlank_6276edbc-cc09-4569-9050-f70f77ab2ac8, "MOO_KethericsChambers_Plank", 1);

PROC
PROC_BlockPickupOfItem(_Character, (ITEM)S_TWN_CentralSquare_RitualDagger_2b07d6f1-d698-47e2-9531-500cbffd9853)
AND
NOT DB_TWN_CentralSquare_TookDagger(1)
THEN
DB_CustomPickupItemResponse(_Character, (ITEM)S_TWN_CentralSquare_RitualDagger_2b07d6f1-d698-47e2-9531-500cbffd9853, 0);
PROC_TWN_CentralSquare_StartAltarDialog(_Character);

IF
DialogEnded((DIALOGRESOURCE)LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_Skull_eebdd5aa-cb4d-4a97-3be8-c8956437476b, _ID)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_State_NoScroll_663377b5-ff20-4909-b5da-75c996d9a5fa)
AND
DB_DialogPlayers(_ID, _Player, _)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_SkullToPlayer")
THEN
Transform(S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_Skull_72104d6e-365a-4ccf-8ad1-c7d448c9e403, (ITEMROOT)PUZ_Cazador_Skull_Ancient_A_0cc92889-414e-4dc9-9fba-f900325c3d64, POLYMORPH_a0ddddc8-255f-4014-9f63-d7608eb1c2a0);
ToInventory((ITEM)S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_Scroll_591d390d-68b7-4937-9103-3772493ab132, _Player, 1, 1, 1);
